title: Simple Economy
description:
Lightweight economy plugin for Paper.
Earn money from valuable ores
body:
Earn Money
Every valuable ore grants a random reward:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Coal: $1.00 – $1.50
- Copper: $2.00 – $2.50
- Iron: $4.00 – $5.00
- Redstone: $7.00 – $9.00
- Lapis Lazuli: $11.00 – $13.00
- Gold: $12.00 – $14.00
- Amethyst: $20.00
- Diamond: $50.00 – $60.00
- Emerald: $75.00 – $90.00
- Ancient Debris: $200.00

</details>
Harvesting fully grown crops also rewards money:**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroot: $1.50
- Cocoa: $2.00
- Nether Wart: $2.50
- Melon, Pumpkin: $2.00 – $3.00
- Sugar Cane, Cactus: $0.25 – $0.50
- Bamboo: $0.25
- Mushrooms, Sweet Berries: $1.00

</details>
Chopping natural (not player-placed) logs rewards money:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Oak, Spruce, Birch Log: $1.00
- Acacia, Dark Oak Log: $1.20
- Jungle, Mangrove Log: $1.50
- Cherry Log: $2.00
- Crimson/Warped Stem: $2.50

</details>
Killing mobs rewards money:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Chicken: $1.00
- Cow, Sheep, Pig, Squid: $2.00
- Rabbit: $1.50
- Zombie, Skeleton: $3.00
- Creeper: $5.00
- Enderman: $10.00
- Blaze: $12.00
- Ghast: $15.00
- Wither Skeleton, Evoker: $20.00
- Ravager: $30.00
- Elder Guardian: $50.00
- Wither: $500.00
- Ender Dragon: $1,000.00

</details>
Fishing also rewards money depending on what you catch:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Cod, Salmon: $0.50 – $0.75
- Tropical Fish: $1.50
- Pufferfish: $2.00
- Nautilus Shell: $5.00
- Enchanted Book: $15.00
- Name Tag: $10.00
- 
</details>
Defeating another player transfers 10% of their balance to you (PVP cooldown applies per player pair).

Commands
- /balance — Show your own balance
- /bal — Shorthand for /balance
- /balance <player> — Show another player's balance
- /balance log — Show your recent transaction history
- /pay <player> <amount> — Transfer money to a player (requires confirmation above $1,000)
- /baltop [page] — Show the richest players on the server
- /sell — Open the sell GUI
- /sell hand — Sell the item in your hand
- /sell all — Sell all sellable items in your inventory
- /settings — Open settings (language can be switched between English and German here)
- /eco give <player> <amount> — Admin: give money (OP only)
- /eco take <player> <amount> — Admin: deduct money (OP only)
- /eco set <player> <amount> — Admin: set balance (OP only)
- /eco reset <player> — Admin: clear balance (OP only)
- /eco log <player> — Admin: view transaction log (OP only)
- /eco gui — Admin: open the admin GUI (OP only)
- /eco reload — Admin: reload config and language files (OP only)




**/settings to change the language**
